planets.name: HR 858 b
planets.description: HR 858 b crosses its star every 3.59 days and is 2.0 times as wide as Earth, found in 2019.

text.card: HR 858 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HR 858. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
